name: Clean water

guide.summary: Replace part of the water under the brush with clean water.
guide.biology: Changing some of the water dilutes whatever is dissolved in it, as a water change does in an aquarium.
guide.rules: Choose 25 %, 50 % or 100 % and a brush radius of 1, 3 or 6. In each covered open cell or bead, that share of every dissolved food, nutrient, chemical, enzyme and phage unit leaves the dish and is logged as removed; oxygen and carbon dioxide there return to this habitat’s starting level. Organisms, deposits and food objects stay. Clean water is an ordinary undo point.
guide.example: Clean the water over a patch where Pinphage units are spreading, then watch the Pinphage overlay.

where: Open cells and beads; stones and walls are skipped.
dose: Removes {fraction} of every dissolved food, nutrient, chemical, enzyme and phage unit there.
changes: Oxygen and carbon dioxide there return to this habitat’s starting level. Removed material leaves the dish and is logged.
doesNotChange: Organisms, deposits (starch, oil, protein, debris, film) and food objects.
watchFor: Whether the life there recovers, or loses its food.
